name: Space Environment Effects on Materials
summary: Covers what the space environment does to materials, from atomic oxygen erosion to radiation and micrometeoroids, and how spacecraft materials are chosen and tested.

topics.name: The space environment: vacuum, thermal cycling, UV, charged particles and debris
Outgassing, contamination and ASTM E595 screening
Atomic oxygen erosion in low Earth orbit and protective coatings
Ultraviolet and particle radiation degradation of polymers and optical coatings
Thermal-control materials: coatings, paints, optical solar reflectors and MLI
Cold welding and tribology in vacuum
Micrometeoroid and orbital debris shielding (Whipple shields)
Radiation effects on spacecraft electronics and shielding choices
Planetary surface environments: lunar regolith dust and Martian conditions
In-space testing (MISSE) and materials for in-space manufacturing
